title: Comparative analysis of bioactives and protein characteristics in six genotypes of yam bean tubers

Yam bean (Pachyrrhizus spp.) is a diverse genus of high-moisture tuber crops with useful agricultural properties but limited nutritional and health benefits due to its low nutrient density.
